title: posting_allowed hardcoded true: 440 response is dead code
description: In lifecycle.rs, posting_allowed is set to true unconditionally in both run_plain_session and run_session_io. The 440 Posting not permitted response branch is unreachable dead code. Wire it to a config field (e.g. ReaderConfig::read_only) if operator-controlled read-only mode is planned, or remove the dead branch to avoid misleading maintainers.
